data.content_ref: inline:The target is a one-way derivation ("abstracts", "This means...") from SRC_005 to a principle about SRC_001. It is refuted under its own stated refutation clause: exhibit a system where intervening on a shared cause changes failure rates without altering any component's input history. Such systems are routine — a static load-sharing redundancy pair. The shared cause (ambient temperature spike) instantaneously raises both failure rates at the moment of intervention without changing the prior input history of either component. The intervention changes rates through a present-state stressor, not by rewriting memory/history. The target's own refuter is thus realized, and its proposed abstraction (failure-dependence = memory-dependence) is false. Note this is a content-level fault (the stated refuting condition is met), not a claim that a machine-evaluated schema is violated.
